result.detail: No tool run backs any statement here. One item for review: interface spec section 8 asks for a formal proof, and the microarchitecture plans proofs at both address widths. formal.run takes only one .sby file. The proof should be planned as a follow-up task, either with one job per width in separate tasks or with a single job using a [tasks] section. I did not submit a formal_spec I could not check. Testbench check IDs are grouped by test: 1-26 reset and channel tasks, 100 reset values, 200 LOAD strobes and orders, 300 SLVERR policy, 400 CTRL fields, 600 one-shot, 700 IE on pending, 800 periodic, 900 expiry kept, 1000 CTRL on end edge, 1100 stop and restart, 1200 simultaneous read and write, 1300 reset during a count.
